_what: The two stores' age-rating questionnaires, answered from the design document. Each answer quotes the sentence it rests on, or, where no sentence of the design decides it, says why from the build; server/src/privacy.mjs --check fails if a quote is no longer in the document or an unquoted answer gives no reason. Question names are the questionnaires' as of the 2025 forms; check them against the live form when filing. §20.1 rates the game 13+ on purpose, above what its content alone would get.

chosen.quote: Rating: 13+ on the App Store, chosen on purpose even though the content alone would likely rate 9+

apple.question: Parental controls
apple.quote: Protections by age band
apple.why: The age bands set the protections; there is no parental control in the app.

apple.question: Age assurance
apple.quote: at first launch the game asks the platform for the player's age band

apple.question: Unrestricted web access
apple.why: The app has no web view; its one link, the terms of use, opens in the device's own browser (client/scripts/workshop_screen.gd).

apple.question: User-generated content
apple.quote: Workshop islands are structured data — laws, terrain, guards, layout — not files

apple.question: Messaging and chat
apple.quote: From version 1.1: up to 30 Keepers, joined through the Beacon from Keeper level 6: a founder, up to four elders, and members. Chat, shared replays and shared heist plans.
apple.why: Chat arrives with constellations in version 1.1; the launch build has none. Answer again when it ships.

apple.question: Advertising
apple.quote: no advertising identifiers

apple.question: Profanity or crude humor
apple.quote: Safety: island names come from word lists, every island can be reported, featured islands are reviewed by a person, and players aged 13 to 15 browse curated lists only (20.7).
apple.why: No free text anywhere: every name a player gives comes from the game's word lists.
